statement: The local p-adic section conjecture and global consequences. Proves that rational points on every smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus at least two over a finite extension of ℚp correspond bijectively to conjugacy classes of sections of its full arithmetic étale fundamental group. It also proves Grothendieck's section conjecture over ℚ for the modular curves $`X_0(N)`$ and $`X_1(N)`$ of genus at least two.
